definitions.explanation: To cause something open to become closed. A transitive verb. The intransitive pair is {閉|し}まる (shimaru).

examples.japanese: ドアを{閉|し}めてください。
{窓|まど}を{閉|し}めましょうか？

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pair: {閉|し}まる (intransitive). Pattern: Xを{閉|し}める (close X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {閉|し}めている = 'have closed' or 'is keeping closed' (not actively closing).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・ドアを{閉|し}める (close the door)
・{窓|まど}を{閉|し}める (close the window)
・{目|め}を{閉|し}める (close one's eyes)
・{店|みせ}を{閉|し}める (close a store/shop)

PAIR: {閉|し}まる (intransitive) - ドアが{閉|し}まった (the door closed). Opposite: {開|あ}ける (to open - transitive).
